Title: IoT Hub integration to Event Grid now in preview

Body.Content:
Azure IoT Hub integration to Event Grid is currently in preview. By integrating with Azure IoT Hub, Event Grid increases support for device lifecycle events, and provides an easy way to automate actions such as database updates, ticket creation, and billing management—all without human intervention.

Learn more.

Watch video.
